memoryBuilder.verseText: Nobody who belongs to Jesus will be told off that day.

sequence.prompt: What will happen on that day? Put it in order.

items.label: Every wrong thing will be put right

matches.prompt: Match each one to what the story says.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: God will put every one of them right
Jesus, with scars on His hands
That day is not one to dread

application.question: God will put every wrong thing right. What unfair thing could you hand to Him?
application.followUp: Nothing will be missed and nothing forgotten — which is wonderful news if you have ever been treated unfairly. And look who is holding the scales: the one who took your punishment and said it is finished. The Judge saved me.
